verdict.rationale: Docusign provides REST APIs and SDKs (docusign-docs-21, docusign-docs-22, docusign-docs-13/38) that developers use to build custom signing flows, and a hands-on account confirms building an 'embed signing room' inside a custom app (docusign-comm-6). However the evidence pack lacks first-party documentation specifically describing the embedded-signing feature/flow (e.g., recipient view/embedded signing ceremony API) beyond generic API references. missing for 10: dedicated first-party docs on embedded signing ceremony/recipient view, UI customization within an embedded iframe, and independent corroboration beyond one community anecdote.
